description: MCP server for Dynatrace Managed to access logs, events, and metrics.
name: io.github.dynatrace-oss/dynatrace-managed-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of tool calls allowed per rate limit window. Defaults to 20.
environmentVariables.name: DT_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_CALLS

environmentVariables.description: Rate limit window size in milliseconds. Defaults to 20000 (20 seconds).
environmentVariables.name: DT_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS

environmentVariables.description: An escaped JSON array that defines the Dynatrace Managed environment(s) to connect to. See README file for contents of this.
environmentVariables.name: DT_ENVIRONMENT_CONFIGS

environmentVariables.description: Logging level (e.g. debug, info, warning, error)
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
